intro: The dig site is chaos. Between you and the landing pad: a mob of Boyz, and behind them, a Nob with a very big choppa.

victory_broken.text: Grizzgut staggers back, bleeding and furious. 'DIS AIN'T OVER, STUNTY!' He flees into the smoke, and the path to your ship is clear.

victory_negotiated.text: Grizzgut squints at you, then at the tunnels. 'Bigger fight dat way? ...Fine. But I'm comin' back for ya.' He stomps off, and his Boyz follow.

defeat.text: The world goes dark. You wake on your own deck, Dorrik's iron hand on your shoulder. 'Dragged you out myself. Don't make a habit of it.'

intro: An Ork raider swings across your bow, guns glowing. It is ugly, slow, and absolutely covered in weapons.

victory_broken.text: The raider's engines cough and die in a gout of black smoke. You don't stay to loot it. You burn hard for open space.

defeat.text: Your ship is crippled, venting air and spinning. The raider loses interest and turns back to the burning world. Dorrik patches the worst of it, at a cost.
